transcript.content: Hi — before we begin, I want to be transparent: you're chatting with an AI assistant, not a human agent. I can help with your subscription and answer account questions. If anything needs a person, I'll hand you to one.
Your price is getting hard to justify. I want to cancel.

I completely understand — cost has to make sense, and I'd like to find a way to make this work for you. I can set up a 3-month pause on your plan, so you won't be billed during it. Would you like to go ahead with that, or should I process the cancellation?
A 3-month pause works — please set that up.
Great — I'll get that 3-month pause going on your plan. Glad we could keep you.
